recognize_zh: 這是毛細管區帶血紅素電泳圖：除 Hb A（61.6%）外，在 Z(D) 區出現一個大峰 Hb D（35.3%），Hb A2 3.1% 正常，未見 Hb S 或 Hb F 峰，符合異型合子血紅素 D 的圖形。
features: Capillary zone electrophoresis tracing with labeled migration zones
Dominant Hb A peak in Z(A) at 61.6%
Second large peak in Z(D) labeled Hb D at 35.3%
Hb A2 peak in Z(A2) at 3.1%, within normal range
No peaks in Z(S), Z(F), Z(C), or Z(E)
describe_en: Capillary zone hemoglobin electrophoresis shows Hb A 61.6%, a variant peak in the D zone of 35.3%, and Hb A2 3.1%, with no Hb S, Hb F, Hb C, or Hb E peak. The proportion of the variant (about one-third of total hemoglobin) is typical of a heterozygous beta-chain variant. The pattern is consistent with hemoglobin D trait, most commonly Hb D-Punjab (Los Angeles), a beta-121 Glu→Gln substitution. Confirmation with an alternative method (HPLC or acid electrophoresis, where Hb D separates from Hb S) or DNA sequencing is advisable, particularly for family counseling given interaction with Hb S.

ddx.vs: Hb S migrates in the Z(S) zone, is positive on sickle solubility testing, and separates from Hb D on acid electrophoresis.
Alpha-chain variants usually comprise about 20-25% and produce a variant A2 peak (G2), whereas beta-chain Hb D is about 35-40% with a normal A2.
Hb Lepore is present at only about 10% and elutes near the A2 zone with microcytosis.
